title: Shadow Checkers computer opponent
summary: Choose a human match or play a private game against four levels of computer opponent.

sections.heading: Shadow Checkers
items: Choose Play Computer for an instant solo game or Play a Person for invitations and live tables.
Rookie, Casual, Challenger and Master levels all follow the same mandatory-jump, multi-jump and kinging rules as multiplayer.
Computer thinking runs on your device so it does not block the 3D room or create a ranked multiplayer match.
Restart to load this update in the Home Screen app or TestFlight.
